Author: Macki
Name: Glance
Description: Public beta. Meet your character's gaze when you zoom in, with an occasional wink and smile. Configure with /glance. Camera tracking and expression timing are experimental. Icon created with AI assistance.
Punchline: A little eye contact. A little personality.
Changelog: Zooming out now immediately resets the facial expression with /straightface, cancels queued expressions, and retries neutral once after 0.65 seconds.
